id.description: Name shown in the list. Defaults to `ssh`, or to `local` for the entry without `ssh`.

short.description: Shorter name for list rows; the footer and the new-session picker keep `id`.

ssh.description: Alias or host from your ssh config (key auth; faplex never prompts). The entry without it is this machine.

dir.description: Default start directory for new sessions there (default `~`).

path.description: Extra PATH entries on the host. `~/.local/bin`, `~/.bun/bin` and `~/.opencode/bin` are always added.

color.description: Label color for the host (hex). Defaults to a palette color by position.

machines.description: Machines to list besides this one. This machine is always listed; an entry without `ssh` names or configures it.

archiveAfterHours.description: A finished session untouched for this many hours moves to Archived: how quickly Finished empties.

closeHiddenAfterMinutes.description: A session client not shown for this many minutes is closed. The agent carries on in its daemon.

uploadDrops.description: With a remote session open, a pasted or dropped path to a local file is copied to the remote machine's temp directory and the path there is typed instead.

opencodeMini.description: Offer OpenCode Mini (`opencode mini`, the scrollback-style interface) as its own choice in the new-session picker, and open sessions started that way in Mini.
